fields.name: post_migration_token_supply
docs: because DBC allow user to swap over the migration quote threshold, so in extreme case user may swap more than allowed buffer on curve
that result the total supply in post migration may be increased a bit (between pre_migration_token_supply and post_migration_token_supply)
